title: Side band
description: Which empty band beside the catch playfield holds the ledger. Right sits under osu!'s score and accuracy, clear of the key counter; left can meet osu!stable's in-game leaderboard.

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves the ledger horizontally from its default spot (1920×1080 px), for skins that place HUD elements differently.

title: Nudge Y / px
description: Moves the ledger vertically from its default spot (1920×1080 px).

title: Scale
description: Size multiplier, 0.5–2. On the left band the ledger grows away from the playfield.

title: Backing
description: scrim: a soft dark haze behind the text that fades out on every side (default; keeps it readable over bright skins and backgrounds). none: bare text with a shadow. panel: a graphite 18-LAB panel.

title: Accent
description: Colour of the live marker and panel rule: a tone taken from the map's background, or 18-LAB amber. Judgement colours never change.

title: Compact
description: Drops the column headings, proportion bars and max-achievable readout; keeps counts, misses, combo status, accuracy and combo.

title: Show accuracy
description: Shows accuracy and the maximum accuracy still reachable if every remaining object is caught (needs vosu's or tosu's /api/calculate/pp for the map's object counts).

title: Show 18—LAB tag
description: The small brand tag at the left of the header.
